title: 2 instructions / Example: UI transformation with rules applied
content: ## Example: UI transformation with rules applied If you ask the AI to redesign your UI, for example: - making it look like an 80s arcade | Before | After | | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | | ![Screenshot of the calculator app after applying the 80s arcade theme](../images/customizations/ep-2-8-calc-retro.png) | The AI will: - apply your design request - enforce accessibility rules at the same time This shows how instructions persist across tasks, not just specific prompts.
